'''George Webber Barlow''' (June 15, 1929 – July 14, 2007) was an American [[ichthyology|ichthyologist]], an [[ethology|ethologist]] (animal behaviorist) and [[evolutionary biologist]] specializing in fish.<ref>[http://www.berkeley.edu/news/media/releases/2007/07/30_barlow.shtml "Ichthyologist, animal behaviorist George Barlow has died"] ''UC Berkeley News''.</ref><ref>[https://www.jstor.org/stable/1448755?seq=1#page_scan_tab_contents "If You Use a Screen Reader"]</ref><ref>[https://www.sfgate.com/bayarea/article/George-W-Barlow-noted-fish-biologist-2526583.php "George W. Barlow - noted fish biologist"]</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://senate.universityofcalifornia.edu/inmemoriam/georgewebberbarlow.html |title=George Webber Barlow |accessdate=2015-10-08 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304113211/http://senate.universityofcalifornia.edu/inmemoriam/georgewebberbarlow.html |archivedate=2016-03-04 }}</ref> Barlow was a well-known expert on [[cichlid|cichlid fishes]]. 

==Tribute==
''[[Apistogramma barlowi]]'' <small>[[Uwe Römer (ichthyologist)|U. Römer]], & [[Ingo J. Hahn|I. J. Hahn]], 2008</small>, a dwarf cichlid was named in Barlow's honor.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.practicalfishkeeping.co.uk/content.php?sid=1657 |title= New dwarf cichlid named after cichlid biologist |publisher= [[Practical Fishkeeping]] |author= [[Heok Hee Ng]] |date= 16 June 2008 |accessdate= 1 January 2016 |url-status= dead |archiveurl= https://web.archive.org/web/20130626213543/http://www.practicalfishkeeping.co.uk/content.php?sid=1657 |archivedate= 26 June 2013 }}</ref>
